assessments.mechanism: Separate shared dynamics learning from task adaptation via an online world model plus MPC/CEM planning.
assessments.clean_scope: ICML 2025 continual-RL setting with shared state space/dynamics and reward-changing tasks; reward functions are provided. Not evidence for arbitrary nonstationary dynamics or open-ended task discovery.
assessments.o_comparison: No inspected O artifact implements or evaluates continual online dynamics learning with reward-conditioned planning. O's durable/runtime replay and Context Kernel are not model-based continual-RL learning.

assessments.mechanism: Replay can be non-monotonic and harmful; replay selection/alignment matters rather than replay quantity alone.
assessments.clean_scope: Strongest theorem is over-parameterized continual linear regression; neural SGD experiments broaden the warning but do not establish that replay is generally harmful.
assessments.o_comparison: O preserves immutable execution replay and development evidence, but that is not training-data rehearsal. No continual-learning replay-count/selection experiment was found.

assessments.mechanism: Curvature/Fisher-aware replay with KL constraints to stabilize interfering directions while preserving plasticity.
assessments.clean_scope: Evidence is from online continual-learning vision benchmarks with K-FAC/Fisher approximations; transfer to large autoregressive models is unverified.
assessments.o_comparison: No Fisher/K-FAC continual-learning replay or stability-plasticity training mechanism was found in inspected O state.

assessments.mechanism: Small replay rates plus gradient alignment for continual LLM pre-training.
assessments.clean_scope: Llama-family continual pre-training across languages at large token scale; exact rate-dependent optimum still requires primary-table extraction.
assessments.o_comparison: No O mechanism or measurement matches continual LLM pre-training with rehearsal plus gradient-alignment updates.

assessments.mechanism: Avoid repeated learning-rate re-warm during continual pre-training using an infinite schedule.
assessments.clean_scope: Reported across image SSL and autoregressive LM continual pre-training; exact table deltas and replay interaction were not yet extracted by the clean worker.
assessments.o_comparison: No inspected O training loop exposes or evaluates continual-pretraining LR re-warm/infinite scheduling.

assessments.mechanism: Schedule replay in model-time derived from cumulative optimizer-update magnitude rather than wall-clock steps.
assessments.clean_scope: ACL 2026 continual-learning evidence across three benchmarks and 0.6B-13B models; primary OP/BWT and overhead numbers remain pending verification.
assessments.o_comparison: O has deterministic runtime/event clocks, but no optimizer-magnitude model-time replay mechanism or continual-LM replay study.

assessments.mechanism: External memory relocates stability/plasticity; abstract procedural memories can outperform raw trajectories and retrieval granularity is task dependent.
assessments.clean_scope: Preprint evidence on ALFWorld and BabyAI; effects are directional/task-structure dependent and do not justify a universal abstract-memory rule.
assessments.o_comparison: O already separates durable Episodes/Candidates/fragments from active decision context, recursively routes optional context, and rejects copying all raw context. However it has not directly compared raw trajectories versus abstract insights or the reported retrieval/storage granularities on matched agent tasks.
